notes.title: The Shadowletter - February 2025
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139261/c4a28b37b57f67affa0892f2d8547a2d44d9cbba.jpg[/img]

Welcome to the February Shadowletter!
Time flies, and here we are again with the new monthly update on Scary Shadow Spot. This month brings exciting news and new milestones achieved. Are you ready?

[h3]A Month of Bitter Glass![/h3]
The second episode of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3354980/Scary_Shadow_Spot__Bicchiere_Amaro]Scary Shadow Spot - Bitter Glass[/url] celebrates its first month on Steam today! A month filled with chills, puzzles, and mysteries in the creepiest saloon of the Wild West.

A huge thank you to everyone who played, shared their thoughts, and supported us! Keep telling us about your experiences—we always love hearing your feedback!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139261/19c9857f1ed6190a789ebaadcc483287c3e609fe.jpg[/img]

[h3]Scary Shadow Spot - All In: The Steam Page is Live![/h3]
Yesterday, we officially launched the Steam page for the third episode: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3536660/Scary_Shadow_Spot__All_In]Scary Shadow Spot - All In[/url]!

This new chapter will take you to a mysterious house where protagonist Lisa must face a poker game unlike any other. The game will feature new mechanics, puzzles, and unforgettable moments of tension.

Don’t forget to add it to your wishlist—it helps us a lot and ensures you receive notifications on future updates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139261/e174f0224ecd962d2ffb04e82ff19410e8bef85a.jpg[/img]

[h3]The Scary Shadow Spot Bundle is Now Available![/h3]
Great news for those who haven’t fully experienced Scary Shadow Spot yet: starting today, you can purchase the official Season 1 bundle!

Find it here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/50896/Scary_Shadow_Spot__Season_01/]Scary Shadow Spot - Season 01[/url]

This bundle lets you get both of the first two episodes at a special price. If you haven’t played Last Farewell and Bitter Glass yet, this is the perfect chance to catch up and prepare for the third episode!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139261/1ba0f902343941515c915ad209394cc01dfa9dd0.jpg[/img]

[h3]What’s Next?[/h3]
February has been a month of major progress in the development of All In. We’re working hard to make this experience even more intense and packed with chilling details. Stay tuned for more updates!

Thank you once again for your support, your reviews, and for being part of the Scary Shadow Spot community.

[b]Happy haunting![/b]
Daniele and the Scary Shadow Spot team

notes.title: Scary Shadow Spot - Bitter Glass
notes.content:
[i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3354980/Scary_Shadow_Spot__Bicchiere_Amaro/]Scary Shadow Spot - Bicchiere Amaro[/url][/i] is finally available on Steam!
After months of work, the second episode of the Scary Shadow Spot series is ready to take you on a journey into psychological horror, filled with eerie puzzles and hidden truths.
[hr][/hr]
[h2]A Cursed Saloon and the Mystery of John Doe[/h2]
This time, you’ll be thrown into the heart of the Wild West, in a forgotten saloon lost in the desert. Here, time has stopped, and the ghosts of a dark past are waiting… for you.
Who is John Doe? What really happened at Bicchiere Amaro? Only by exploring the saloon and solving its puzzles will you uncover the truth.
[hr][/hr]
[h2]A Psychological Horror Inspired by The Twilight Zone[/h2]
Like the first episode, Bicchiere Amaro draws inspiration from the legendary series The Twilight Zone, delivering a story shrouded in mystery, with plot twists that will make you question everything you think you know.
[hr][/hr]
[h2]What to Expect[/h2]
✔️ A chilling and surreal atmosphere.
✔️ Puzzles that will test your logic.
✔️ A cast of… dead characters.
✔️ A story that will pull you in until the final revelation.
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Add the Game to Your Wishlist![/h2]
If you enjoyed [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3096050/Scary_Shadow_Spot__Ultimo_Addio]Ultimo Addio[/url], you’ll love [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3354980/Scary_Shadow_Spot__Bicchiere_Amaro/]Bicchiere Amaro[/url] too. And if you haven’t played the first episode yet, now is the perfect time to catch up!

💀 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3354980/Scary_Shadow_Spot__Bicchiere_Amaro/]Scary Shadow Spot - Bicchiere Amaro[/url] is available NOW on Steam!
📌 Add it to your library and let us know what you think in the comments!

notes.title: The Shadowletter - January 2025
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313778/87f436aa0a13a315184b3a742d6dd87570891e0e.jpg[/img]

Welcome to the January Shadowletter!
2025 has started with great energy, and we're ready to share an important announcement that we can't wait to celebrate with you! The second episode of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3354980/Scary_Shadow_Spot__Bicchiere_Amaro]Scary Shadow Spot - Bitter Glass[/url] will launch on Steam on January 31st. We're incredibly excited about this release and hope you are too!

[h3]One Week to Launch![/h3]
The tension is building, and so is our eagerness to show you everything we’ve prepared for this chapter. Bitter Glass is bigger, richer, and even more immersive. Unlike the first episode, we’ve brought back collectibles, a fan-favorite feature from our studio.

This time, we’ve added something special: collectible "Wanted" western posters. We’ve partnered with famous streamers and YouTubers who will appear in the game as collectible posters. Additionally, through our Instagram contest (@doesntmatterpod), we selected 20 random participants who will also be immortalized in the world of Bitter Glass. A true celebration of our community!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139261/b443b3ed16db4ee6a1c2bcafe64b776a5bb3eea3.jpg[/img]

[h3]The Commercial Break Returns![/h3]
Just like in the first episode, Bitter Glass will feature a commercial break. Those who played Last Farewell might remember the simulated 1950s cigarette ad that interrupted a climactic moment in the story. Since Scary Shadow Spot is inspired by The Twilight Zone, we want to preserve the TV series format with all its iconic elements. This time, the commercial break will be even more surprising and memorable.

And remember: in the meta-universe of Scary Shadow Spot, some characters from the first chapter may return in future episodes in different roles. Just like in a TV series, characters are like "actors" playing different roles in each episode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139261/0e357855b139dfa5de72f62d14e357c2c2b7617d.jpg[/img]

[h3]A Look Ahead: Scary Shadow Spot - All In[/h3]
We can’t help but give you a little teaser about the future of the series. Work on the third chapter, titled Scary Shadow Spot - All In, has already begun! The protagonist will be Lisa, a woman who must face a mysterious poker game with fate. What happens during this game will be as emotional as it is unsettling. But we’ll talk more about that later...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139261/493a844e4f38c350f2daf15b61587b61ccc1b8af.jpg[/img]

[h3]Countdown![/h3]
We’re confident that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3354980/Scary_Shadow_Spot__Bicchiere_Amaro]Bitter Glass[/url] will leave you breathless. Add the game to your [b]wishlist[/b] if you haven’t already, and get ready to immerse yourself in the most haunting saloon of the Wild West.

Thank you again for your support and for being part of the Scary Shadow Spot community. See you on January 31st for the launch!

[b]Happy haunting,[/b]
Daniele and the Scary Shadow Spot team

notes.title: The Shadowletter - December 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139261/8484d67f3d18b844b4348ceb7d4d571ebff7c99c.jpg[/img]

Welcome to the first Shadowletter!
The start of a new tradition: a monthly newsletter where we’ll share updates, fun facts, and contributions from the amazing Scary Shadow Spot community! Looking back, we can’t help but admire how far we’ve come. The journey is long, but it’s filled with mysterious shadows and unforgettable stories. Thank you for being part of this adventure!

[h3]2024: A Year in the Shadows[/h3]
This has been an intense year for us and the Scary Shadow Spot universe. Here are some key moments:
[list]
[*] Launch of Scary Shadow Spot - Last Farewell: The first episode landed on Steam, delivering unforgettable chills. Thank you for your incredible support!
[*] Announcement and development of Scary Shadow Spot - Bitter Glass: The second episode promises to be even more chilling.
[*] The birth of the Shadowletter: What you’re reading is the first of many monthly updates. A special thanks to our community for inspiring us daily.
[*] New ideas, new horizons: We’re working on several projects and can’t wait to share more with you in the coming months (work on the third episode is already underway!).
[/list]

[h3]Let’s Create Together![/h3]
We dream of seeing the [b]Scary Shadow Spot community[/b] grow and blossom with creativity. If you enjoy drawing, writing, modding, or creating videos, share your work with us! Post them on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/Eskv5TZcgj]Discord server[/url] or tag us on social media. Your creations might feature in future Shadowletters. We can’t wait to see what you’ll create!

[h3]Behind the Scenes: Work in Progress[/h3]
People often ask us: “How do you come up with new ways to scare players?” Without spoiling too much, we’re currently working on a puzzle involving a poker game with a ghost. We challenge you to win against the otherworldly… if you dare.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139261/af0d342e104fba5708357f98838c38ea11799e6d.jpg[/img]

Meanwhile, progress on Bitter Glass is going full steam ahead: we’re perfecting the saloon’s atmosphere and enriching the stories of its spectral inhabitants.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139261/1ed77b6886d7a98442a1b7ceec02e62dbe0b4394.jpg[/img]

[h3]Special Event: Shadow Fest![/h3]
The holiday season is here, and we want to celebrate with you! Join our Shadow Fest by sharing your Scary Shadow Spot-themed creations. It can be a drawing, a story, a mod, or even a video. Post them on our Discord server or tag us on social media. All participants will receive an exclusive seasonal role on our Discord server!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139261/81c210081b8d72f9a7e792f6f24a112b2db74a02.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139261/524b946a73f28f2b3c8e80a7054f67bebcfca660.jpg[/img]

[h3]A Huge Thanks[/h3]

We recently surpassed 2,000 wishlists on Steam for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3354980/Scary_Shadow_Spot__Bitter_Glass/]Scary Shadow Spot - Bitter Glass[/url]! This milestone is thanks to you. Your trust motivates us daily to create unique and memorable experiences. As a token of our gratitude, we’ve prepared an exclusive desktop wallpaper featuring the Bitter Glass saloon. [url=https://www.doesntmattergames.com/downloads/]Download it from our official website[/url]!

Until the next Shadowletter, remember: the shadows always have a story to tell.

[b]Happy haunting[/b]!
Daniele and the Scary Shadow Spot team
